summary: Backend-only testing of the AUVC Go bot stats-per-user feature, leaderboards, migration 0008, and the standalone cosmetics_inventory.py script. Ran gofmt, go vet, full go test ./... (all packages pass), the project's Python unittest suite (64 tests), verify_repository.py, and a new pytest suite that exercises migration 0008 data preservation and the standalone cosmetics script. Added one extra Go edge-case test (unlinked rounds folded into account when later linked under a different case) which also passes. No code changes to product code.
critical_code_review_comments: stats.go RecordRound/foldNameIntoUser is correctly transactional and uses COLLATE NOCASE on player_link lookup plus lowercase for name:<key>, so case-folding is consistent on both the lookup and the fold step.
PlayerStats query appends ', last_name LIMIT ?' as a tiebreaker on top of the switch's ORDER BY - correct and deterministic for all three boards.

Migration 0008 preserves rounds/wins/impostor and sets impostor_wins to default 0 (expected; feature is new). last_name is seeded from the historical player_name so the leaderboard still shows a sensible name right after upgrade.
handleStats escapes names via EscapeMarkdown and appends 🔗 for linked accounts - prevents markdown injection via in-game names.
cosmetics_inventory.py has zero repo imports, uses only stdlib + optional UnityPy, and runs from any cwd (verified from '/'). Missing aa folder yields clear argparse error (exit 2).

Minor nit (not fixed): catalog_keys() uses isinstance check in a somewhat awkward conditional expression `data.get(...) + data.get(...) if isinstance(data, dict) else []` which only works because `data` is checked after the concat; if `data` is not a dict, `data.get` would AttributeError. In practice `json.loads` of a non-object yields non-dict and would raise AttributeError before the isinstance check runs. Consider rewriting as early guard: `if not isinstance(data, dict): continue`. Low priority.
updated_files: /app/bot/pkg/storage/sqlite/stats_edge_test.go (new test only, no product code changed)
seed_data_creation: pytest test builds a synthetic Among Us folder (Among Us_Data/StreamingAssets/aa with catalog.json + dummy .bundle) and an in-memory sqlite DB walked through migrations 0001-0008 - all torn down with TemporaryDirectory.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Go toolchain at /usr/local/go/bin. Run `cd /app/bot && export PATH=/usr/local/go/bin:$PATH && gofmt -l . && go vet ./... && go test ./... -count=1`. Python regression: `cd /app && python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_*.py'` and `python3 -m pytest test_reports/pytest/`. verify_repository.py also passes. cosmetics_inventory.py has an awkward isinstance check (see code review); not a bug today but worth tightening.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - all requested features verified working. The user's original cosmetics_inventory.py failure was a user-local path issue (running from C:\Users\fabia without a repo checkout); the current script is self-contained and the updated docstring documents fetching it alone via raw GitHub URL. Verified by copying the script to an arbitrary dir and running with cwd='/' - exits 0 and produces valid JSON.
